module: Grid selector utility: manages display options (sorting, display filters, toggles...), the favorites list and the recent items list, with JSON persistence in a file (default /settings/gridSelectorData.json). An option can be linked to a game setting via `settingsKey`. Emits the hooks onGridSelectorDisplayDataChanged and onGridSelectorFavouriteToggled.
notes: Data is loaded lazily on first access (getDisplayData). If the file version is lower than targetVersion, `updateDisplayDataFunction(displayData, 0, targetVersion)` is called to migrate.
The keys `showAuxContent` (initial value = not shipping_build) and `showCareerContent` (forced to false in shipping builds) get special handling at initialization.
Only options with `save = true` are actually written back into displayData on save; resetDisplayDataToDefaults also resets only those options.
Favorites store the os.time() timestamp; recent items are limited to 100 (most recent first).
Options linked to `settingsKey` read and write via settings.getValue/settings.setValue.

create.desc: Creates a display data, favorites and recents management instance.

displayDataOptions.desc: List of options { key, type, default, label, min, max, options, showInModes, description, hideInSimpleMenu, save, settingsKey }.

backendName.desc: Name passed to the hooks, default "gridSelector".

getDisplayData.desc: Returns the key -> value table of the options, initialized on first call.

setDisplayDataOption.desc: Changes an option (converted to a number if its type is number), emits onGridSelectorDisplayDataChanged(backendName, key, value), propagates to the linked setting and saves. nil or "undefined" values are ignored.

resetDisplayDataToDefaults.desc: Resets the `save` options to their default value, emits the hook for each change and saves.

toggleFavourite.desc: Adds or removes a favorite, emits onGridSelectorFavouriteToggled(backendName, itemKey, isFavourite) and saves.

isFavourite.desc: Returns the favorite's timestamp or nil.

returns.desc: os.time() of when it was added.

isRecentItem.desc: Returns the position in the recents list, or false.

trackRecentItem.desc: Puts the item at the head of the recents (max 100) and saves.

getRecentItems.desc: Returns a deep copy of the recents list.

initializeDisplayData.desc: Re-reads the file and rebuilds the options table from the defaults, the file and the linked settings.

returns.desc: New table (does not overwrite the internal cache).

getDisplayDataOptions.desc: Returns the options list for the UI: label, key, type, min, max, value, options, showInModes, description, hideInSimpleMenu. The value of `searchText` is always nil (handled by the calling module).
